Priya (CS): Quick flag — midterm budget scrub: we saw a 3.8x spike in token usage for account Nebula during their activation window overnight. Not sure if it's legit activity or a replay loop. Can ops/products take a look?

Ben (CSE): Yikes. :eyes: I saw repeated embed jobs for the same batch id in logs. Might be retry storms from the client SDK. Pasting a quick grep: `grep 'embed_batch_id=az-9' /var/log/nebula/embeds.log | wc -l` returned 4200 entries vs expected ~120.

Ava (Finance): If that holds, daily burn could jump by ~40% for them this month. We need a conservative spend forecast for the QBR deck. Can we get a 7-day extrapolated run-rate and a suggested guardrail?

Diego (Solutions): I'll reach out to Nebula PM to confirm whether they pushed a bulk ingestion job. @Priya any scheduled enablement session this week? Might coincide.

Priya (CS): We have a kickoff tomorrow at 14:00 PT. I'll ask them to pause ingestion until we verify. Also want to capture feedback: if SDK retries are too aggressive, playbook update needed.

Ben (CSE): Quick remediation steps I can run now: 1) throttle embed workers for nebula 2) enable per-account dedupe on batch id 3) temporary quota cap. OpsBot can you run the quota command?

OpsBot: /run set-quota --account nebula --daily-tokens 5000000 --reason "activation surge triage"

OpsBot: Result: quota updated successfully. Previous daily limit 15000000 -> new 5000000.

Ava (Finance): Thanks. Please also attach a CSV with actual token usage by hour for the past 72h so I can run a scenario table for the QBR. Ideally columns: timestamp, tokens_consumed, request_count, model_variant.

Ben (CSE): I'll export that now and drop in the shared folder. `rw billing export --account nebula --hours 72 --format csv --fields ts,tokens,requests,model`

Priya (CS): Action items so we don't lose them: - Ben: confirm root cause & add dedupe fix (in ticket) - Diego: confirm whether client-run ingestion occurred - Ava: produce 3 scenario spend slides (base, activation, runaway) - Priya: call with Nebula tomorrow 14:00 PT, ask for pause / rollback.

Diego (Solutions): Noted. I'll ping the Nebula PM right now.

Ben (CSE): Initial look: SDK was upgraded last week; there's a suspicious change to backoff. I'll bisect and open PR if confirmed.

Ava (Finance): If we need to propose a temporary credit or one-time invoice adjustment for onboarding noise, flag it in the QBR ask column.

Priya (CS): Yep — add a row in the QBR asks: "one-off onboarding credit + joint runbook". Also capture customer feedback: they want clearer default retry/backoff guidance in docs.

OpsBot: Deploy Bot: scheduled throttle applied 2026-03-18T06:12:08Z — monitoring for 1h.

Ben (CSE): Monitoring shows token rate dropped ~75% in last 20m after throttle. Keeping watch.

Priya (CS): Great — we'll keep the QBR prep doc updated. I'll attach a short customer quote capturing the confusion around SDK defaults. That will help product prioritize the retry-backoff doc fix.

Ava (Finance): Send me the exported CSV link once Ben uploads. I'll have scenario tables by EOD so we can bake numbers into the QBR deck.

Priya (CS): Thanks team. Closing loop when we have post-call notes. :white_check_mark:
